labels.rationale: The terms identify product concepts and are understandable in this audience-specific quick-start context.
“Detects” and “asks” clearly describe automated behavior and a displayed confirmation prompt.
The passage presumes every reader’s experience and makes broad, unsupported claims about all competing tools.
Saying tools “want” configuration and “know” about peers misleadingly attributes human intentions and awareness.
“Each one,” “them,” and “others” clearly refer to the previously introduced AI coding tools.
In “compound it,” the pronoun vaguely refers to complexity inferred from earlier discussion, not a clear noun.
“Layers three things” is a conventional description of product functionality, not misleading human attribution.
“Will degrade” describes a predicted consequence of a later translation, making future tense meaningful.
“Decides what to do” vaguely attributes judgment to software instead of describing its deterministic provider handling.
The compatibility command predicts degradation that would occur during translation, so future tense is justified.
“This page describes” pre-announces the page’s contents instead of stating the information directly.
“This page covers” is explicit navigational preannouncement that can be removed without losing technical meaning.
“The user” refers to the reader indirectly; second-person “you” would be clearer and more direct.
This states current provider behavior, so “does not expand” is more direct than “will not expand.”
“Widely reusable” describes the intended scope of global content and is supported by concrete examples.
Whether “these patterns” has a clear referent depends on preceding content that the supplied passage omits.
“Just” minimizes registry requirements, even though the required content structure makes the qualification important.
Claiming the AI “understands” attributes cognition where processing or using metadata would be technically clearer.
“Asks you to confirm” accurately and conventionally describes an interactive command-line prompt.
